meta.title: Fatih Škrijelj — Architecture & Interior Design
meta.description: Portfolio of Fatih Škrijelj, architecture student and former architectural technician from Sarajevo: architecture, interior design and 3D visualization.

hero.subtitle: Architecture & Interior Design
hero.lead: I design homes and interiors and make the renders, from the first sketch to the build. Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.

about.title: I learned to build first
about.p1: I'm {age}, an architecture student from Sarajevo in my fourth year of studies. Before university I trained and worked as an architectural technician, so I learned how buildings are put together before I learned how to design them.
about.p2: I've worked on residential, commercial and urban projects, spent seven months in a design studio, and more than ten of my projects have been built. So I draw with the building site in mind: every detail has to be buildable.

services.title: From sketch to build
services.intro: One person through the whole process: concept, technical drawings and renders for homes, offices and interiors.

items.title: Architectural Design
items.body: Homes, offices and mixed-use buildings designed from the first sketch to a buildable plan.

items.title: Interior Design
items.body: Kitchens, bedrooms and living spaces that are comfortable, functional and built around the client.

items.title: 3D Visualization
items.body: Photoreal renders that show the light, materials and mood of a project before it is built.

tools.title: Tools I Work With
tools.intro: From construction drawings to final renders, I work across the full digital workflow, from the first line to the finished image.
tools.next: finish my studies, gain experience in a respected firm, and one day lead a practice of my own.

contact.title: Let's talk about your space
contact.lead: Planning a house, refitting an apartment or need renders of a design you already have? Tell me a little about it and we'll take it from there.

steps.title: Write to me
steps.body: A few lines about the site, the scope and your timeline.

steps.title: First conversation
steps.body: We go through your ideas, budget and what the space needs to do.

steps.title: Design & visuals
steps.body: Sketches, drawings and renders, refined together until they're right.
